response.explanation: The change made the forEach callback async in vital/lib/reschedule.ts and wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts, and added `await getCalendar(...)` inside it. The surrounding try/catch used to catch a synchronous throw from getCalendar. forEach ignores the promise the async callback returns, so a rejection from getCalendar (for example a failed dynamic import in appStore) or from deleteEvent is no longer caught. The same pattern is in bookings.tsx around lines 553-566, which has no try/catch at all. The reschedule flow also does not wait for the calendar deletions, so it can continue or return before they finish. I checked every other getCalendar caller (EventManager, handleCancelBooking, handleNewBooking, CalendarManager, videoClient and the payment code). They all await the result correctly.
response.title: Async forEach callback escapes try/catch, so getCalendar/deleteEvent failures become unhandled rejections
